messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use Albuterol if you are allergic to albuterol.
You should not use ProAir RespiClick or ProAir Digihaler if you are allergic to milk proteins.
To make sure albuterol inhalation is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have:
heart disease, high blood pressure, congestive heart failure;
a heart rhythm disorder;
a seizure disorder such as epilepsy;
diabetes;
overactive thyroid; or
low levels of potassium in your blood.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.
It is not known whether albuterol will harm an unborn baby.
However, having uncontrolled asthma during pregnancy may increase the risk of premature birth.
It may also increase the risk of low birth weight.
It may also increase the risk of eclampsia.
Eclampsia is dangerously high blood pressure.
Eclampsia can lead to medical problems in both mother and baby.
The benefit of preventing bronchospasm may outweigh any risks to the baby.
If you are pregnant, your name may be listed on a pregnancy registry.
The registry is used to track the effects of albuterol on the baby.
Triplet: ["Eclampsia", "defined as", "dangerously high blood pressure"]

The relation 'defined as' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject condition is characterized by or defined as the medical condition or description specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Choices:
A. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
D. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
